notes: Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Units differ: the SCI (p.8) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. Revenue and expenses from 15.1.1 (columns non-participating / participating / PAA / total): 2568 revenue p.162 and expenses p.163, 2567 revenue p.164 and expenses p.165. The CSM roll-forward and new-business tables under note 11.1 have no number: 'กระทบยอดการวัดมูลค่าองค์ประกอบ... - ไม่รวมสัญญาที่วัดมูลค่าภายใต้วิธีการปันส่วนเบี้ยประกันภัย' runs over p.91-93 (2568) and p.94-96 (2567); 'ผลกระทบของสัญญาที่รับรู้ในรอบระยะเวลา' p.97 (both years). Opening CSM is the net opening (liability + asset row). Future-service change = change in estimates (CSM column). The income tax line, labelled 'expense (income)', prints the FY2025 and FY2024 credits in brackets (profit before tax + credit = net profit); they are stored as credits (+). Other revenue (อื่นๆ) is nil in 2568 and 7,238 in 2567. RA release uses 15.1.1, equal to the AOC RA. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses.
